purpose: Manage outbound Tesla Fleet API availability, automatic polling participation and runtime-published deployment endpoint metadata.
primaryGoal: Independently allow manual routes and opt eligible routes into automatic polling without confusing suspension, availability and scheduling.

dataSources.name: application-settings
dataSources.behavior: Settings supply api_suspended. Read forwards AbortSignal; preserves inherited query policy.

dataSources.name: polling-configuration
dataSources.behavior: Returned catalog determines identity, method, path, category and pollability. Maps determine access and auto selection; SLOW staleTime and AbortSignal retained.

dataSources.name: runtime-version
dataSources.behavior: Chart/Go version, OS/architecture and endpoints map; STANDARD staleTime and optional refetch interval retained.

dataSources.name: polling-settings-write
dataSources.behavior: Live-only write; serializer removes catalog and filters alias map entries by valid catalog/pollable keys. Success updates cache, invalidates polling-config/capture-stats; localized success/error toasts.

dataSources.name: resume-api-actions
dataSources.behavior: Page sends suspended=false only; live-only mutation with settings invalidation/broadcast and success/error toasts.

components.name: FleetAPIPage / useFleetAPIPage
components.role: Thin mounted orchestrator plus domain state, filters, counts and mutations

components.name: PageLayout / PageContainer
components.role: Existing full-width layout, localized header, aggregate freshness and independent source notices

components.name: FleetAPIBrief / AdminSummary / OperationalBrief
components.role: Three typed metrics through useOperationalMetrics and shared OperationalBrief; no replacement KPI renderer needed

components.name: FleetAPIPolling
components.role: Master scheduler switch, polling explanation, emergency suspension notice and resume action

components.name: FleetAPIEndpointControls / FleetAPIRouteActions / FleetAPIRouteCatalog
components.role: Existing endpoint control card, bulk actions, search, grouping, sorting, category navigation and group tables

components.name: FleetEndpointTable / DataTable
components.role: Sole table pipeline; five columns, value filters, stable IDs and inherited local-table export/persistence

components.name: FleetAPIConfiguredEndpoints / LayoutCard
components.role: Runtime version and four deployment-managed endpoint slots, each rendered using existing GlassPanel/Code

components.name: Existing category primitives
components.role: Toggle, Button, Input, Select, Badge, GlassPanel, IconBox, typography, Skeleton, EmptyState, QueryError, InlineCallout and FadeIn are reused. No new primitive required.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: pollingKnown repeats the controller's catalog/config availability expression in EndpointControls, Polling, RouteActions and Brief.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Consume controller.pollingKnown in these existing components; do not create a competing availability abstraction.

sourceStrategy: Route actions use sm:grid-cols-3 plus flex-wrap bulk controls; search uses min-w-0 flex-1.
Catalog group navigation wraps labels; sorting wraps and uses sm:ms-auto.
Configured endpoints use one column, md two columns and 2xl four columns; metadata breaks words/URLs.
All five table columns remain present; DataTable defaults to horizontal scrolling when no mobile adapter/column policy is supplied.

issues.rule: MDC-043 / mission 15 / intentional mobile table strategy
issues.detail: No mobilePresentation, mobileColumns or visibleOnMobile is supplied. Shared fallback retains the whole five-column table via horizontal scroll (DataTable.tsx:238-248).
issues.fix: Review fallback at required widths; if a card adapter is needed, reuse DataTable.mobilePresentation and preserve every method/path/access/auto field and action. Do not simply hide columns.

responsive.viewportValidation: UNVERIFIED: 320/375/390/430/768/1024/1280/1440/1920/2560, allocated container widths, long paths, RTL and 200% text were not exercised.

sourceEvidence: Switches have localized aria-labels including endpoint method/path; Toggle uses a real button, role=switch and aria-checked (Toggle.tsx:90-114).
Grouping/category controls use aria-pressed and route navigation has a localized aria-label (FleetAPIRouteCatalog.tsx:19-67).
Search and sort Select have localized accessible names; nonpollable dash has Not scheduled title/name.
LayoutCard associates its heading ID with its surface (LayoutCard.tsx:20-37).

issues.detail: sm track is h-5 w-9 and md h-6 w-11; these classes size the actual interactive button. Endpoint/bulk switches use sm and master uses md. Source dimensions are below the contract's 44px target height; spacing exceptions and effective hit regions are not measured.
issues.fix: Shared owner should retain track geometry while providing a 44px interactive hit target or document a measured spacing exception; preserve role, naming, disabled and click behavior.

issues.detail: The polling section has no aria-labelledby/aria-label connecting it to its PanelTitle, unlike LayoutCard's heading association.
issues.fix: Associate an explicit stable heading ID with the existing section; keep title and content intact.

issues.detail: Grouped section aria-label uses raw group while its visible heading uses groupLabel(group). Category navigation is localized but region name can remain backend English.
issues.fix: Use groupLabel(group) or associate the translated heading; retain raw group identity for tableId/filtering.

accessibility.validation: UNVERIFIED: keyboard, focus, screen reader, effective contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and touch behavior. FadeIn is reused but its implementation was not inspected.

states.initialLoading: Independent source skeletons: polling, route catalog and four configured endpoint slots. Brief skeleton only when neither settings nor polling has data and one is loading.
states.emptyUnavailable: Catalog unavailable explains runtime update/restart with Retry. No search matches offers Clear search. Empty configured metadata explains deployment-managed configuration/restart. Polling missing config uses localized text.
states.fatalErrors: Each section uses deriveDataState.fatalError and source-specific QueryError/refetch, not a single page-wide destructive error gate.
states.retainedRefresh: deriveDataState distinguishes retained data from initial failure. Brief labels stale/refreshing/partial; PageLayout passes all three named sources to PageContainer's nonfatal DataSourceNotice. Retained catalog/config remains visible.
states.mutations: Master, bulk and endpoint switches disabled while polling mutation pending; Resume disabled during suspension mutation. Hook owns live-only guard and success/error toasts.

issues.detail: Mutations spread retained pollingConfig and are disabled only by isPending. Catalog and bulk actions follow the same pattern; no page-level stale/offline guard is passed. Request requiresLiveMode is a safety guard, not evidence that a retained configuration is current.
issues.fix: Define an integration policy for retained configuration writes: preserve retained display, surface source-specific refresh warning and retry; avoid overwriting newer server state. Do not invent concurrency APIs or change live-only semantics.

states.offlineValidation: UNVERIFIED: offline/paused source transitions, mutation rejection, retained-source warning visibility and toast announcements were not exercised.

visualIssues.detail: IconBox applies neonColorMap bg/ring/text. Page calls blue, cyan and dynamic green/blue at ConfiguredEndpoints:17, EndpointControls:20 and Polling:19. tokens.ts:21-26 maps those backgrounds/rings to neon classes. The glow entries exist in tokens but IconBox does NOT apply c.glow; no active glow is asserted.
visualIssues.fix: Shared owner should provide restrained neutral/semantic IconBox presentation through existing tokens; preserve color/size compatibility and keep legitimate status meaning distinct from decoration.

visualIssues.detail: Summary icons separately use emerald-400, cyan-300 and amber-300 although all three are routine configuration summaries. Shared Toggle also hardcodes cyan-500/600 (Toggle.tsx:123). Source has hue/saturation emphasis; actual perceptual noise and contrast remain unmeasured.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer neutral icon tokens for ordinary summaries, retain amber only when paused is intentionally meaningful, and route switch emphasis through shared semantic tokens.

architectureIssues.detail: Access and auto columns have rich Toggle renderers but no exportValue. Rows are FleetEndpoint descriptors, not access/auto map values. Operation uses column key operation while raw field is key. DataTable exports visible columns by matching row[column.key] or rendered text (DataTable.tsx:881-892); switch renderers have no readable children, so exports cannot reliably contain actual boolean configuration. Operation JSON falls back to transformed display text.
architectureIssues.fix: Supply canonical exportValue callbacks for operation/access/auto, retaining null/not-scheduled semantics separately from false. Preserve method/path, table IDs, filtering and CSV/JSON actions; add focused export cases.

architectureIssues.detail: hasConfiguredEndpoints checks any map key, but rendering filters only api/web/oauth_callback/tesla_api. A nonempty map containing only other keys takes the success branch with no endpoint cards, and additional published keys are not represented. Actual backend extra keys were not inspected.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve all four established labeled slots; ensure the success/empty decision matches displayable entries and explicitly handle any additional published metadata rather than silently discarding it.

architectureIssues.detail: Default selectedGroup is fixed to Vehicle data. If a valid nonempty catalog lacks that category, endpointGroups is empty yet the message describes a search mismatch and Clear search cannot reset the group.
architectureIssues.fix: Keep the existing default for catalogs that contain it; provide a reset-to-all action/fallback for unavailable selected groups while preserving grouping and search semantics.

priority.rationale: Already decomposed and using canonical layout, brief and table owners. Prioritize export data fidelity, unknown metadata/selected-group recovery, shared switch targets and subdued decorative icons before source-only polish.
priority.acceptance: Phase0 SOURCE audit complete only; page implementation/runtime acceptance is not claimed.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained IconBox presentation

props.need: Neutral/semantic existing-token presentation without neon decorative backgrounds/rings; no new palette or parallel icon wrapper

requiredSharedChanges.qualification: Evidence is from three consumers within this page only; cross-page adoption and new API eligibility belong to the shared owner, not this audit.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Toggle hit-target and semantic emphasis

props.need: 44px reachable interactive height with unchanged visual track sizes and token-based semantic active/focus colors

requiredSharedChanges.qualification: Do not change density preferences or enlarge every track; measure effective hit targets and any WCAG spacing exception in shared validation.

reuse: PageLayout delegates to PageContainer; no second width/layout engine.
AdminSummary delegates to OperationalBrief/useOperationalMetrics; no parallel stats formatter.
FleetEndpointTable delegates to DataTable; reuse export, filters and opt-in mobile API rather than building another table.
All settings mutations remain in existing typed API hooks; no page fetch/useEffect pipeline.
competingImplementations.limits: No global duplicate-component search was performed; this report cannot establish absence of competing owners outside the inspected dependency graph.

preservation.lineCountScope: 33 page + 177 controller + 32 brief + 72 polling + 56 controls + 67 configured endpoints + 65 actions + 100 catalog + 90 table. Excludes shared AdminSummary/foundation owners.

sourceFrameCounts.note: Literal source instances in page-specific presentation files; one GlassPanel repeats for configured endpoints. Runtime card/group counts depend on payload.

actions: Enable/disable master automatic polling; does not disable manual requests or token refresh.
Resume previously suspended API actions (false payload only).
Enable/disable access per endpoint; disabling pollable endpoint access clears its auto selection.
Change auto selection only when master enabled and endpoint access allowed.
Bulk access all across entire catalog, not just current table/search; disabling clears pollable auto map.
Bulk auto all eligible routes across catalog; respect pollability/access/master state.
Search key/method/path/category; nonempty search switches selected group to all.
Switch category/method grouping; reset selected group to all.
Sort name/path/method/access/auto and toggle direction; state sorts initially descending.
Clear search on no matches and independently retry polling/settings/version failures.
Retain existing inherited DataTable value filtering, column/persistence controls and local CSV/JSON export; no row selection explicitly enabled.
dataBehavior: Preserve catalog endpoint identities and raw maps; no fake catalog or backend capability guesses.
Preserve typed live-only writes and serializer allowlists, cache keys, invalidations, settings broadcast and localized mutation toasts.
Summary totals are full returned catalog counts, independent of table search/group filters. Unknown summary metrics remain undefined, not zero.
Preserve independent source rendering and retained data on refresh errors, source labels and source-specific retries.
No physical SI measurements are transformed here. Raw configuration/version metadata must remain intact; no legacy unit converter introduced.
Keep deployment metadata read-only, all explanatory notes, four existing endpoint labels and version context.
Keep stable tableId admin:fleet-endpoints:${groupBy}:${group}, keyExtractor endpoint.key and candidates scoped to the underlying group.
Preserve initial category grouping, Vehicle data default where valid, name ascending default and current search/group transitions.
Workspace vehicle/date controls are not added: this page manages global settings, not dated vehicle observations.

evidenceLimits.scope: Only assigned page and concrete dependencies were inspected; router slices/searches were restricted to verifying its five actual API operations. Route array is the supplied assignment, not independently mounted-route proof.
evidenceLimits.visual: NOT RUN; no screenshots, effective contrast or viewport acceptance claimed.
evidenceLimits.tests: NOT RUN; no TypeScript, full-repository lint/build, Git or production mutations.
evidenceLimits.skillAudit: audit-violations skill and its script read. Script execution omitted because its unconditional step 7 runs project TypeScript, outside this source-only assignment. Bounded regex counts were run instead.

sourceChecks.command: PowerShell Get-Content over the nine explicitly listed page-specific files; regex matches for style=, raw button/input/textarea/select/table, direct recharts/react-leaflet/framer-motion imports and neon/glow/white utility patterns
sourceChecks.qualification: These are lexical counts, not a complete compliance pass; shared IconBox neon decoration and saturated Toggle tokens are separately traced above.

evidenceLimits.backend: Router path/method matches confirmed by source. Backend payload validation, scheduler implementation, catalog completeness, update atomicity/concurrency and deployment endpoint shape remain unknown; no capabilities invented.
evidenceLimits.sharedReadDepth: Shared owner inspection is limited to directly relevant props/renderers and source search excerpts. OperationalBrief, motion, notices, export browser downloads and formatting internals were not exercised or fully audited.
